column1: # frequency_uk.txt carries 3206 entries with Russian-only letters, and `что`
# is its 8th most frequent "Ukrainian" word (49617). Because the index
# promotes anything it contains, these are accepted as valid Ukrainian --
# so a layout flip can land on a Russian word and a guess can rank one above
# `verdict = fix` because these ARE mistakes when typing Ukrainian. Expect
# this bucket to stay at zero until the frequency list is regenerated
